name: CasaOS Personal Cloud Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source personal cloud dashboard and Docker application manager for running self-hosted apps on Linux hardware; no software-imposed monthly app deployment quota.
watch_out: CasaOS is a self-managed software platform, not a free cloud server. You supply and maintain Linux hardware, Docker, disks, networking and electricity; individual apps may have their own licensing and costs.
